newsitem.title: USA: N. Dakota unemployment rises to 3.1 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: N. Dakota unemployment rises to 3.1 pct in June.

text.p: North Dakota's unemployment rate rose to 3.1 percent in June, but hit the lowest point recorded for the month since 1959, the job service department reported Thursday.
The unadjusted rate rose four-tenths of a percentage point over May. North Dakota reported a 3.5 percent unemployment rate a year ago and 4.8 percent in 1993, the department noted.
In seasonally adjusted terms, North Dakota unemployment dropped to 2.7 percent in June from 3.3 percent in May, the department reported. The seasonally adjusted rate in 1993 was 4.4 percent.
The construction sector showed the largest increase in employment in nonagricultural wage and salary jobs for June over May, with all areas but government reporting increases, the department said.
